grammar.summary: 本课围绕饮食偏好的差异展开，重点运用了与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句、No...more than 比较结构以及 where/who 引导的定语从句。体会作者如何用虚拟语气设想「假如你住在地中海」、用比较结构强调蜗牛受毁誉之极、用定语从句补充背景信息。

points.title: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句 (Second Conditional)
points.explanation: 表示与现在事实相反的假设，if 从句用一般过去时（be 动词用 were），主句用 would/could/might + 动词原形。本课用此结构设想「假如你住在地中海地区，你会把章鱼当作美味」，凸显饮食偏好的地域性。

examples.en: If you lived in the Mediterranean, for instance, you would consider octopus a great delicacy.
examples.cn: 比如，如果你住在地中海地区，你会把章鱼视作是美味佳肴。

examples.en: You would not be able to understand why some people find it repulsive.
examples.cn: 同时不能理解为什么有人一见章鱼就恶心。

points.title: No...more than 比较结构 (Comparative with no)
points.explanation: No + 名词 + 比较级 + than 表示「没有比……更……的了」，用比较级形式表达最高级意义。本课用 No creature has received more praise and abuse 强调蜗牛所受毁誉之极，是文中点睛之笔。

examples.en: No creature has received more praise and abuse than the common garden snail.
examples.cn: 没有一种生物所受到的赞美和厌恶会超过花园里常见的蜗牛了。

points.title: where/who 引导的定语从句 (Relative Clauses with where/who)
points.explanation: where 引导定语从句修饰表示地点的先行词，who 修饰表示人的先行词。本课用 where 修饰 country（罗伯特住的国家），用 who 修饰 countless people（从小知道蜗牛可做菜的人），使背景交代紧凑。

examples.en: My friend, Robert, lives in a country where snails are despised.
examples.cn: 但我的朋友罗伯特却住在一个厌恶蜗牛的国家中。

examples.en: There are countless people who, ever since their early years, have learned to associate snails with food.
examples.cn: 有不计其数的人们从小就知道蜗牛可做菜。

exercises.q: If you lived in the Mediterranean, for instance, you ______ consider octopus a great delicacy.
No creature has received ______ praise and abuse than the common garden snail.
My friend, Robert, lives in a country ______ snails are despised.
用动词的适当形式填空：Acting on a sudden impulse, I collected several dozen, put them in a paper bag, and ______ (take) them to Robert.
课文中 The idea never appealed to me very much 的 appealed to 意思是？
